intro: Guyana is a parliamentary republic with an executive president.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The leader of the party that wins the election becomes president. Irfaan Ali was re-elected in 2025. The National Assembly has 65 seats.

chapters.title: Caribbean ties
text: Guyana hosts the headquarters of CARICOM, the Caribbean community.

keyTerms.meaning: A president who leads the government.
